description: This file defines the NoteMapper class, which provides static methods for converting between Note entity objects and their corresponding DTOs (NoteRequest and NoteResponse). It facilitates mapping data transfer objects to entities and vice versa in a Java application, likely a Spring Boot backend.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to convert between Note entities and their DTO representations.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a NoteRequest DTO into a Note entity by copying title and content.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates an existing Note entity's title and content based on data from a NoteRequest DTO.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Note entity into a NoteResponse DTO, including its ID and timestamps.
